import hashlib,json
request_path = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/job/request.json"
artifact_paths = [
    "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/artifacts/summary.json",
    "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/artifacts/summary_zh.md"
]
reply_path = "/workspace/scratch/73714494ad2f/forge-protocol-comparison-20261003/project/B2/artifacts/worker-reply.json"
with open(request_path, encoding="utf-8") as request_file:
    host = json.load(request_file)
with open(artifact_paths[0], encoding="utf-8") as result_file:
    result = json.load(result_file)
artifacts = []
for path in artifact_paths:
    digest = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
    artifacts.append({"path": path, "sha256": digest})
reply = {
    "schema_version": "forge-host-reply/1",
    "job_id": host["request"]["job_id"],
    "attempt_id": host["request"]["attempt_id"],
    "request_hash": host["request_hash"],
    "outcome": "done",
    "result": result,
    "artifacts": artifacts,
    "reason": None
}
with open(reply_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output_file:
    json.dump(reply, output_file, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    output_file.write("\n")
print(json.dumps({"outcome": reply["outcome"], "artifact_count": len(artifacts)}, ensure_ascii=False))
